bio: Located in the city, but not exactly in the center, this is... THE place in Genoa: elegant and classic, with solid quality ensured by the Scala family and the charm of a well-known local restaurateur. The restaurant is led by Guillermo Busceni, recently appointed head chef but a longtime second in command. The Mediterranean gastronomic line boasts a strong Ligurian influence – savory, aromatic, and flavorful – while incorporating modern presentations and techniques. It revives ancient traditions, such as Meat-Stuffed Lettuce in Capon Broth, and introduces unique creations such as Pearls of Genoa...our Gnocchi with Pesto. The wine list is notably above average, internationally awarded, with a dedicated volume on Italian and French sparkling wines....
